about_short_description.short_description: Coiled is a modern solution for seamlessly scaling data science, machine learning, and AI in Python.

product.name: Coiled Cluster
product.description: A Python API to provision and manage scalable cloud virtual machine clusters for distributed computing workloads.

product.name: Serverless Python Functions
product.description: A service to run Python functions in the cloud with flexible memory, region, and execution time, without Docker or infrastructure management.

product.name: Environment Synchronization
product.description: Automatic replication of local Python environments and dependencies to cloud machines without requiring Docker.

product.name: Coiled API and Web UI
product.description: APIs and web interface for managing cloud compute resources, debugging jobs, and controlling access and costs.

product.name: Batch Jobs on Cloud VMs
product.description: Capability to run arbitrary batch jobs on cloud virtual machines with hardware and environment configuration via script annotations.
